01

Where we are

Panchgani is a hill station in the Sahyadri range of Maharashtra. Our campus spreads across 174 acres of hill country — cool mornings, clear night skies and room to roam.

174acres of campus

A hill campus home to a huge variety of flora and fauna, with organic gardens and rainwater harvesting.

300seats in the dining hall

Five meals a day with menus designed by a dietician — hygiene and cleanliness come first.

24/7nurse on campus

A trained nurse on the campus around the clock, plus regular doctor visits.

Where the day begins

Every morning, the hills lift out of the mist.

5:00AM

Rise & shine

5 AM – 8 AMRise & shine

Wake up to a fresh day

The hills are cool and quiet. Dormitories stir, the call to prayer rings out and the whole house starts the day together.

  • Wake-up and morning prayer in the prayer hall
  • Group yoga and stretching on the lawns
  • Freshen up, tidy the dorm and a wholesome breakfast
8 AM – 4 PMSchool hours

A full day of learning

  1. 8 AMMorning classes
  2. 11 AMHealthy snack break
  3. 11:15 AMClasses continue
  4. 1 PMLunch
  5. 2 PMSchool continues

4 PM – 7 PMPlay

Play, practise, explore

The golden hours belong to the outdoors: the largest sports ground in town, an archery range, horses, a skating rink and clubs for every passion.

  • Cricket, football, hockey, volleyball, basketball, kabaddi, athletics
  • Archery, horse riding, skating, shooting range, gardening
  • Robotics, pottery, music, drama and debate clubs
7 PM – 8 PMDinner

Dinner together

The day’s last meal — warm food, stories from the day and a settled, family feeling.

  • Dinner in the dining hall
  • Evening prayer and a quiet moment
8 PM – 10 PMStudy time

Study, homework & wind-down

Supervised study sessions in the dormitories, supported by peer tutors and resident advisors.

  • Homework and revision with peer tutors
  • Resident advisors and dorm in-charge on hand
  • Reading, reflection and getting ready for bed
10 PM – 5 AMLights out

Rest — and tomorrow begins again

Quiet falls over the dormitories. The dorm in-charge is on duty and a trained nurse is on campus 24/7.

  • Lights out and a good night’s sleep
  • Dorm in-charge on duty; nurse on campus 24/7

02

The timetable

5 AM – 8 AMWake up to a fresh day

The hills are cool and quiet. Dormitories stir, the call to prayer rings out and the whole house starts the day together.

8 AM – 11 AMMorning classes

Digital classrooms with a projector and AV set-up, teachers who love their subjects, labs and a library of e-materials.

11 AM – 11:15 AMHealthy snack break

Fifteen minutes to refuel with something light from the dietician-designed menu — and catch up with friends.

11:15 AM – 1 PMClasses continue

Lessons resume — discussion, hands-on activities, practicals and academic advisors checking progress.

1 PM – 2 PMLunch

The renovated dining hall seats 300. Hygiene is paramount and meals are supervised for balance and nutrition.

2 PM – 4 PMSchool continues

Afternoon lessons, labs and coaching — including the NEET, JEE, CET, NATA and CA tracks.

4 PM – 7 PMPlay, practise, explore

The golden hours belong to the outdoors: the largest sports ground in town, an archery range, horses, a skating rink and clubs for every passion.

7 PM – 8 PMDinner together

The day’s last meal — warm food, stories from the day and a settled, family feeling.

8 PM – 10 PMStudy, homework & wind-down

Supervised study sessions in the dormitories, supported by peer tutors and resident advisors.

10 PM – 5 AMRest — and tomorrow begins again

Quiet falls over the dormitories. The dorm in-charge is on duty and a trained nurse is on campus 24/7.

Indicative timetable — exact timings will be confirmed by the school.
